title: Never Use This Plane To Reveal The GTA 6 Map
sources: Engadget: You can reveal the full GTA 6 map in minutes using this simple plane trick
Beebom: How to Remove Map Fog in GTA 6 (crop duster, civilian aircraft safer)
xboxplay.games / games.gg guides: unfog the map fast; military base jets bring a wanted level (star count differs between guides, so not stated)

lines.text: Do NOT fly a military jet to uncover the GTA 6 map!
When you start, most of the map is hidden under fog.
The fastest fix is flying a plane over the unexplored areas.
Guides say stealing military aircraft near a base can bring a wanted level, and fighter jets after you.
A civilian crop duster is the safer pick.
Guides say it has plenty of fuel and doesn't attract fighter jets.
Fly slow, scan the fog, and the map fills in.
Some details are still early guide info, so check them in game.
Would you fly the safe plane, or steal the jet anyway? Comment it!
